0022600005.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Lakers hosting the Warriors. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Lakers a 65% chance to win, and Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed) and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The Lakers are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions for Adou Thiero (undisclosed), Cameron Carr (undisclosed, bruise), Collin Sexton (lower leg) and Jarred Vanderbilt (undisclosed), and the Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 119-103 win in San Francisco on April 9, 2026.
